risks.risk: Walker lateral drift from requested crossing x could change the law-relevant point/body crossing location.
risks.source: original actor-poses.jsonl and requested_path in both exact cases
risks.metric: max absolute pedestrian_x_m minus requested_path.x_m during roadway frames
risks.failure_condition: Any source frame crosses the surveyed crosswalk boundary contrary to requested case, or lateral error persists through roadway entry.
changed_knobs: lateral correction clamp from 0.2 to 0.4 in Native walker direction only
fixed_conditions: law, actor, cell, case IDs, crossing x targets, route y and speed policy, 600 frames at 20 Hz, four camera identities and dimensions, required observations
risks.selection_rule: Use fallback1 only after original Native source-measured primary lateral drift triggers failure; select both linked cases with same controller policy; never select by desired legal result.

risks.risk: Business-district applicability and complete marked/unmarked crossing inventory are unsupported by original map readback.
risks.failure_condition: Missing independently sourced district frontage/boundary or complete crossing inventory.
risks.selection_rule: Repair source geometry/evidence and audit before finalization; a controller fallback cannot resolve source absence.
